# no-space-in-code

- ID: `MD038`
- Category: Code
- Default: on, severity warning
- Fixable: yes
- Tags: `whitespace`, `code`

Code span text has no spaces around it, except one each side or by a backtick.

## Why

Extra spaces are usually accidental, and they can change how the code renders.
One space on each side is padding that renderers remove, and a space beside a
backtick in the code keeps it apart from the delimiter.

## Options

This rule has no options.

## Fix

The fix deletes the extra spaces. gomdlint may report a finding without a fix
when the fix would change a line with one character in brackets, such as \[x\]
or \[1\], or the lines around it up to a blank line, because it could add or
remove a task list checkbox.

## Configure

Under `rules`, `no-space-in-code: false` turns the rule off and
`no-space-in-code: error` reports its findings as errors. The flag
`--disable no-space-in-code` turns it off for one run.

## Silence one line

```markdown
<!-- markdownlint-disable-next-line no-space-in-code -->
```
